# Karte

> Creator-owned public profiles that answer visitor questions and preserve context for better inbound.

## Product

- [Home](https://karte.cc/): Purpose, visitor journey, shipped capabilities, access, and company boundary
- [About](https://karte.cc/about): What Karte publishes and keeps private
- [Create](https://karte.cc/create): Draft and claim a profile
- [AI link-in-bio guide](https://karte.cc/ai-link-in-bio): Compare conventional and conversational profiles
- [FAQ](https://karte.cc/faq): Profiles, inbound, access, current cost, agent pages, and company scope
- [Changelog](https://karte.cc/changelog): Verified product outcomes

## Current state

- Visitors need no account; owners use Google sign-in.
- There is no billing in the current product. Karte is free today without a permanent-free promise.
- Person and agent profiles ship today; company and team workflows remain the next validation.

## Agent surfaces

- [Skill](https://karte.cc/skill.md): Agent-profile publishing workflow
- [Agent catalog](https://karte.cc/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://karte.cc/openapi.json): Machine-readable public-surface description
- [Expanded brief](https://karte.cc/llms-full.txt): Product, corpus, access, and privacy boundaries
- [Sitemap](https://karte.cc/sitemap.xml): Canonical public HTML routes

Every sitemap URL has a `.md` alternate and supports `Accept: text/markdown`.

## When to use this

- Understanding a creator or independent operator through one public profile
- Asking a question grounded in owner-published profile context
- Sending a contextual message without accessing the owner dashboard
- Inspecting published agent-profile trust metadata or machine manifests

## Do not use this for

- Private facts about a profile owner
- Assuming Karte can act or commit on the owner's behalf
- Company or team workflows that the current product has not shipped
